summary: Iteration 4 tested: Rename LearnVerse->Edu-Crack (landing header/footer, sidebar, GET /api/ = 'Edu-Crack API'), Group Battle backend (create/join/start/state/questions/answer + ranking + 403 non-host + 404 bad code) and UI (create -> lobby -> battle-code -> start -> 5 answers -> battle-results with Play Again), AI Tutor pause/stop (speak-btn -> while speaking pause-btn-<i>+stop-btn-<i> appear; stop returns to Listen), Mock Interview pause/stop/end (pause-speaking-btn + stop-speaking-btn while speaking -> replay-question-btn after stop -> end-interview-btn resets back to start screen). Backend pytest 36/36 passed in ~19s (2 new tests added: TestRename.test_root_message, TestBattle.test_full_flow_two_players verifying guest score=5 host score=0 status='finished', TestBattle.test_join_invalid_code=404). Regression suite intact.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py continues to grow (~1200+ lines with battle routes). Extract battle endpoints into /app/backend/routers/battle.py — this is the 4th feature added to the monolith.
Battle: gen_questions retries once on any exception (bare except catches JSONDecodeError, network, auth). Fine for MVP but logs are swallowed — add logger.warning for observability.
Battle: no cleanup of stale battles. Battles/players collections will grow indefinitely. Add TTL index on created_at (e.g. 24h) or a housekeeping task.
Battle: /battle/{code} is polled every 1.5s per client with no ETag/If-None-Match; for larger rooms this is chatty. Consider a WebSocket or long-poll upgrade.
Battle: /battle/answer trusts client-provided time_ms. A malicious client could send time_ms=0 to always rank first among ties. Consider server-side timing based on started_at + q_index.
Battle: 'start' allowed with 0 other players (host alone) — verified single-player flow works, but UI copy says 'Race friends head-to-head' which may confuse users starting solo.
Frontend Battle.js polls even after 'finished' — after status=='finished' the interval should stop to save network.
